label: BigNum
description: Large, bold numeric data fields with optional HR and power zone coloring.
releaseNotes: 17 new fields: the lap set (number, time, distance, speed, max speed, heart rate, cadence, max cadence, normalized power, max power, W/kg, VAM, ascent, descent) and navigation (distance to destination, distance to next turn, ETA). Durations under an hour drop the leading 0: and are drawn taller. A value that outgrows its width template now shrinks only if it is wider than the tile, so a 4-digit power keeps its height. Field labels are drawn in capitals, all at the same letter height and on one line.
